instructions: Inspect only the supplied datasheet and the bundled archetype and gold example.
Attempt transfer, output, and capacitance curve extraction before falling back to tables.

Use SI units, preserve axes and test conditions. Keep MOSFET electrical axes canonical VGS, VDS, or ID (including the underscore aliases V_GS, V_DS, and I_D); represent p-channel sign handling only through magnitude_convention, never by adding 'magnitude' to an axis name.

For every non-null critical scalar, preserve page_reference and add locator with an exact positive-integer page plus non-empty table and row strings. Every threshold datum and every VGS/current/resistance datum in an RDS(on) point must also carry a direct condition object: polarity; magnitude_convention signed or absolute; temperature {status: stated, kind: ambient/case/junction, value_c, provenance}; electrical {vgs, vds, id}; and test_mode. Use exact typed coordinates: fixed has value_v/value_a, relation has relation, range has increasing lower/upper values. Thresholds require vgs and vds relation vds_equals_vgs plus fixed id; RDS(on) requires fixed vgs/id plus vds relation saturation_region. Repeat the identical direct condition on all three RDS(on) datum objects. Only threshold test_mode may be not_stated when the source truly omits it; RDS(on) must state a canonical mode.
For every curve, preserve page_reference and add locator with an exact positive-integer page plus non-empty figure and curve_or_trace strings.

For every curve, provide at least four ordered digitized points and add temperature as kind (ambient, case, or junction), numeric Celsius value, and canonical provenance inline_condition, table_heading, figure_label, footnote, or section_scope; omit the curve when temperature is not stated.

For transfer curves, electrical_bias must contain exactly one fixed VDS or V_DS record; for output curves it must contain exactly one fixed VGS or V_GS record. For other curves, record each explicitly fixed VGS, V_GS, VDS, V_DS, ID, or I_D bias with an exact numeric value and unit; omit the curve when no fixed electrical bias is stated.

For every curve, add magnitude_convention signed or absolute alongside temperature, electrical_bias, and test_mode. Add test_mode with canonical kind dc, continuous, pulsed, or single_pulse. Pulsed and single_pulse data also require pulse_width_s; include duty_cycle, repetition_period_s, or repetition_frequency_hz only when explicitly stated, and omit the curve when test mode is not stated.
Return one JSON object only, with no markdown fences or commentary.
